patterns: THE REPORT IS STILL STALE AT THE TOP LINE: this Friday run succeeded technically, but the trusted Meta/Google/Facebook/Instagram window still ends on 2026-05-12.
PAID PERFORMANCE IS STILL FROZEN WEEK OVER WEEK: Meta and Google totals are unchanged versus the June 5 export, which confirms the bottleneck is source freshness, not sudden demand collapse.

ORGANIC BACKFILLS CONTINUE TO TRICKLE IN INSIDE THE SAME WINDOW: Instagram website clicks rose by 4, reels reach rose by 197, reels engagement rose by 1, Founder Pro Tips on Instagram added 10 reach, and the top founder-led Facebook reel added 73 average-view-time units without any date-window extension.

FOUNDER-LED, TEACHING, AND OPERATOR-VOICE CONTENT STILL WINS: Founder Pro Tips remains the strongest Instagram post and the strongest Facebook reel, while founder-origin storytelling stays near the top on Instagram.

FACEBOOK STILL RESPONDS BEST TO RELATABLE OR UTILITY-DRIVEN POSTS: the humorous stocking-up post is still the top Facebook post by engagement, while dinner-solve and ingredient-reassurance posts stay close behind.

WISCONSIN + DINNER SOLVE POSITIONING REMAIN THE BEST PAID HOOKS: Straight From Wisconsin still leads Meta creative volume at 13,622 link clicks and $0.11 CPC, and Meet Real Dough Pizza Co. still over-indexes on efficiency at 4.67% CTR.
GOOGLE BRANDED SEARCH IS STILL THE CLEANEST DEMAND POCKET: branded search keeps delivering 5.68% CTR at $0.21 CPC, while competitor terms remain the expensive leak at $0.59 CPC.

THE BUYER PROFILE STILL SKEWS OLDER THAN THE CREATIVE INSTINCT MIGHT ASSUME: age 65+ leads Meta clicks with the best raw CTR, 55-64 stays highly efficient, and Instagram's biggest follower bucket is still 35-44.

recommended_actions: REPORTING: fix the Whatagraph freshness issue before debating weekly winners. The main reporting problem is still that the shared export stops at May 12.
PAID: keep Straight From Wisconsin as the control, but keep spinning variants around founder credibility, practical dinner utility, and ingredient reassurance.
GOOGLE: cap or trim competitor terms first unless Andrew has hard conversion proof that justifies $1,227.77 of spend at $0.59 CPC.
META TARGETING: keep biasing toward 35+ audiences. Older cohorts are still carrying both click volume and efficiency.
ORGANIC IG/FB: keep making founder, pro-tip, and process content. That theme is still the clearest cross-platform proof of resonance.
MEASUREMENT: do not overreact to tiny weekly deltas until the reporting window starts advancing again; they are more likely late backfills than real strategic movement.
week_summary: The June 12 Friday run worked operationally: the Whatagraph report was opened, the Excel path was exercised, and the workbook was parsed into data/whatagraph-data.json. The real issue is still upstream freshness. The trusted window remains stuck at May 12, so this is another validation week rather than a clean new close. Within that constraint, the story still holds: paid scale is working but less efficiently than the earlier checkpoint, branded search is the cleanest demand pocket, Wisconsin/founder/practical-dinner creative keeps winning, and founder-led educational content remains the clearest organic pattern across Instagram and Facebook. The only real movement versus June 5 is small organic backfill inside the same window.
